About Kayashi Jewels

From everyday classics to festive statement pieces, our collections are designed to be versatile, skin-friendly, and effortless to style. Customisation sits at the heart of what we do, allowing you to add your own touch while keeping the soul of Indian jewellery.

Every piece is made with care, blending traditional Kundan and Jadau craftsmanship with everyday wearability. Have a question about a piece, customisation, or an order? Message us directly on WhatsApp — we reply personally to every enquiry.
